title: hardlimit~
description: `hardlimit~` is a brick-hard signal limiter with a residue mixer, intended to limit an input signal and output the limited result. Its controls set the limit level from -50 to 0 dB, the wet/dry mix from 0 to 1, and the residue mix from 0 to 1; these may also be supplied as creation arguments, as in `sigpack/hardlimit~ -8 1 0`.
